en: A vintage multi-view postcard with a dark border and a central scroll bearing a greeting in Hungarian, surrounded by small black-and-white photographs of notable sites in and around the city of Pécs. Each vignette is captioned in Hungarian, showing buildings such as a mausoleum, hotel, theater, school, church, city square, Roman ruins, and villa-lined street. The reverse side has the typical divided-back layout with the printed word 'Levelező-lap', handwritten cursive message and address lines, and a green Hungarian postage stamp canceled with a PÉCS postmark.
